body.purpose: Nav links, insight prose, query answers.

label.purpose: Uppercase mono labels: section label, domain badge, Formula label, KPI card label.

numeral.purpose: KPI values and, at smaller sizes, chart ticks/tooltips, comparison %, timestamps — always tabular IBM Plex Mono.

shadows.name: shadow-sm
shadows.purpose: Defined token, not used at rest anywhere in the shipped UI.

shadows.name: shadow-md
shadows.purpose: Defined token, reserved for future layered states; not currently applied.

shadows.name: shadow-lg
shadows.purpose: KPI detail flyout only — the system's single 'raised sheet' moment.

motion.name: drawer-slide
motion.purpose: Ask-drawer open/close via translateX, deliberately not an animated margin, to avoid layout thrash on the main column.

motion.name: state-fade
motion.purpose: Hover/active state transitions on nav links, cards, and buttons.

components.name: Sidebar Schematic Nav
components.description: Vertical connector line with node dots per section; active dot fills signal-cyan with a glow ring instead of a background highlight.
components.css: .ds-nav { position: relative; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.1rem; padding-left: 0.9rem; } .ds-nav::before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 4px; top: 0.7rem; bottom: 0.7rem; width: 1px; background: rgba(16,20,26,0.24); } .ds-nav-link { position: relative; display: block; width: 100%; text-align: left; font-size: 0.85rem; font-weight: 500; color: #5c6470; background: none; border: none; border-radius: 5px; padding: 0.5rem 0.6rem; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s ease, color 0.15s ease; } .ds-nav-link::before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: -0.9rem; top: 50%; transform: translateY(-50%); width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 50%; background: rgba(16,20,26,0.24); border: 2px solid #fbfbfa; } .ds-nav-link:hover { background: rgba(16,20,26,0.13); color: #10141a; } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0891a8; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-nav-link-active { color: #0891a8; font-weight: 600; } .ds-nav-link-active::before { background: #0891a8; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(8,145,168,0.12); }

components.name: KPI Card
components.description: Hairline-grid cell showing a KPI's mono numeral value and mono comparison badge; no per-card border or shadow.
components.css: .ds-kpi-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(200px, 1fr)); gap: 1px; background: rgba(16,20,26,0.13); border: 1px solid rgba(16,20,26,0.13); border-radius: 8px; overflow: hidden; } .ds-kpi-card { border: none; padding: 1.15rem 1.25rem; background: #fbfbfa; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; width: 100%; transition: background 0.15s ease; } .ds-kpi-card:hover, .ds-kpi-card:focus-visible { background: #ffffff; } .ds-kpi-card:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0891a8; outline-offset: -2px; } .ds-kpi-label { font-size: 0.78rem; font-weight: 500; color: #5c6470; margin-bottom: 0.5rem; } .ds-kpi-value { font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; font-size: 1.7rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.01em; } .ds-kpi-badge { font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; display: inline-flex; margin-top: 0.6rem; font-size: 0.72rem; font-weight: 500; padding: 0.15rem 0.4rem; border-radius: 5px; color: #1a7a4c; background: rgba(26,122,76,0.12); }

components.name: Insight List Item
components.description: Hairline-divided row with a monospace bracket-tag severity marker ([i]/[!]/[x]) instead of a colored left border.
components.html:
• [i]Revenue up 4.2% — driven by higher order volume in March.
  • [x]Delivery rate dropped — on-time rate fell below threshold.
components.css: .ds-insight-list { list-style: none; padding: 0; margin: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; border: 1px solid rgba(16,20,26,0.13); border-radius: 8px; overflow: hidden; } .ds-insight { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 0.6rem; padding: 0.85rem 1.1rem; background: #fbfbfa; font-size: 0.9rem; } .ds-insight + .ds-insight { border-top: 1px solid rgba(16,20,26,0.13); } .ds-insight-tag { font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.72rem; font-weight: 600; flex-shrink: 0; line-height: 1.6; } .ds-insight-info .ds-insight-tag { color: #0891a8; } .ds-insight-critical .ds-insight-tag { color: #c23a3a; }

components.name: Formula / Explanation Ledger Block
components.description: Dashed-rule framed explanation paragraph with an uppercase mono 'Formula' label; replaces a tinted left-border callout.
components.html:
Formula

total_revenue = SUM(order_total) for delivered orders in the selected month.
components.css: .ds-formula-label { font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.68rem; font-weight: 500; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.08em; color: #0891a8; margin-top: 0.75rem; } .ds-formula-text { font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.82rem; line-height: 1.6; color: #5c6470; margin: 0.35rem 0 1.1rem; padding: 0.75rem 0; border-top: 1px dashed rgba(16,20,26,0.24); border-bottom: 1px dashed rgba(16,20,26,0.24); }

components.name: Chart Card
components.description: Bordered card wrapping a Recharts line or bar chart; mono chart label, signal-cyan stroke/fill, mono axis ticks and tooltip.

components.name: Query Box Ask Button
components.description: Primary action button for the 'Ask the dashboard' natural-language query form.
components.html: <form class="ds-query-form"><input class="ds-query-input" placeholder="Ask a question about this dashboard…" /><button class="ds-query-button" type="submit">Ask</button></form>
components.css: .ds-query-form { display: flex; gap: 0.6rem; } .ds-query-input { flex: 1; padding: 0.65rem 0.9rem; border: 1px solid rgba(16,20,26,0.24); border-radius: 5px; background: #fbfbfa; color: #10141a; } .ds-query-input:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: #0891a8; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(8,145,168,0.12); } .ds-query-button { padding: 0.65rem 1.2rem; border: 1px solid #0891a8; border-radius: 5px; background: #0891a8; color: #fbfbfa; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s ease, transform 0.15s ease; } .ds-query-button:hover { background: #066579; border-color: #066579; transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-query-button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #066579; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-query-button:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: default; }

components.name: Close Button
components.description: Square glyph close control shared by the KPI detail panel and the ask drawer; a literal '×' character, not an icon-set glyph.
components.css: .ds-close-btn { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 1.85rem; height: 1.85rem; border-radius: 5px; background: rgba(16,20,26,0.13); border: none; font-size: 1.2rem; line-height: 1; cursor: pointer; color: #10141a; opacity: 0.7; transition: opacity 0.15s ease, background 0.15s ease; } .ds-close-btn:hover, .ds-close-btn:focus-visible { opacity: 1; background: rgba(16,20,26,0.24); } .ds-close-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0891a8; outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview: BIFlow's product truth is that every KPI is a formula, run by an auditable agent, not a black box — so the dashboard is built as an instrument panel / lab-ledger, not a generic SaaS card grid. Surfaces are flat lab-paper (light) or dark-instrument black (dark, via prefers-color-scheme), separated by hairline rules rather than floating shadows, with one committed signal-cyan accent reserved strictly for "this is live." The confirmed anti-reference is the prior dashboard generation (adaptive theme, soft nav highlight, stat-tile cards with individual shadows) — that shell is explicitly not the target; this system replaces its soft highlight sidebar with a schematic connector line, and its floating cards with a shared-hairline grid. The signature move is the type split: every numeral — KPI values, chart axis ticks and tooltips, timestamps — is set in IBM Plex Mono with tabular numerals, while every label, heading, and sentence of prose runs in Geist Sans. This isn't decorative; it makes "this number was computed, not guessed" legible at a glance, which is the whole pitch of a multi-agent pipeline that traces numbers back to formulas. Density is close but not cramped: a fixed 280px sidebar and fixed 400px query drawer bracket a fluid, capped-width reading column, so the KPI grid, trend/breakdown charts, and insight ledger all read as instrument readouts rather than dashboard widgets.
keyCharacteristics: Flat lab-paper/instrument-black surfaces, hairline-separated, not shadow-separated
One signal-cyan accent, reserved for "live" state only
Numerals in IBM Plex Mono (tabular), everything else in Geist Sans
Tightened radii (5/8/10px) read as instrument-panel, not bubbly SaaS
Insight severity and KPI formulas are typographic ledger marks, not colored side-tabs

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Signal-cyan means "live" and nothing else: active nav state, focus, and the formula label. It never represents success, warning, or danger, and status colors never borrow it — so a viewer can always read cyan as "this is the thing currently active," not as a fourth status color.

rules.name: The Mono-Numerals Rule
rules.body: Anything that is a measured or timestamped value — KPI values, chart ticks/tooltips, percent-change badges, "Updated" timestamps — is set in IBM Plex Mono with tabular numerals. Anything that is a label, heading, or sentence is Geist Sans. No component mixes the two within the same text run.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat and hairline-bordered at rest. The one shadow that ships (--shadow-lg on the KPI detail flyout) marks the one panel that is genuinely a layer above the grid, not a decorative default.

dos: Do set every KPI value, chart tick/tooltip, comparison percentage, and timestamp in IBM Plex Mono with tabular-nums; set everything else in Geist Sans.
Do reserve signal-cyan for live/active state only (nav, focus, formula label) — never repurpose it as a fourth status color.
Do separate cards and grid cells with 1px hairlines and shared-gap grids rather than individual shadows; reserve --shadow-lg for the one genuinely lifted surface (the KPI detail flyout).
Do use monospace bracket tags ([i]/[!]/[x]) for insight severity and dashed-rule ledger framing for formula/explanation content.
donts: Don't add colored left-border "side-tab" accents to cards, list items, or callouts — this system replaced that exact pattern (insight rows, the explanation block, query-history turns) with bracket tags and dashed rules; do not reintroduce it on new surfaces.
Don't use hard offset/neobrutalist shadows anywhere in this system — the shadow vocabulary is soft and blurred, and used sparingly.

Don't apply the "§ Overview" mono section-label kicker uniformly above every heading — it currently marks only the Overview section; don't promote it into a system-wide repeated-kicker rule that isn't yet how the build actually uses it.
